product.name: SheetProof
product.slogan: See every change. Merge with intent.
product.taglineZh: 看清每一处差异，再决定如何合并。
product.description: A local-first desktop tool for reviewing and merging changes between Excel .xlsx workbooks, with first-class Git and UGit workflows.
product.descriptionZh: 一款本地优先的 .xlsx 对比与合并桌面工具，面向双文件、Git 仓库与 UGit 工作流。

downloads.status: Desktop installers are under construction. Source builds are available now.

features.title: Workbook-aware comparison
features.titleZh: 理解工作簿语义的对比
features.summary: Compares sheets, values, formulas, explicit blanks, types, and worksheet order instead of diffing OOXML text.
features.summaryZh: 按工作表、值、公式、显式空值、类型与工作表顺序比较，不把 OOXML 文本噪声当成业务差异。

features.title: Side-by-side review
features.summary: Uses synchronized, virtualized grids with focused navigation and Git-style added, removed, modified, and conflict states.
features.summaryZh: 使用同步滚动的窗口化双栏网格，按增加、删除、修改和冲突分类定位真实差异。

features.title: Current-sheet row filters
features.titleZh: 只看当前工作表需要核对的行
features.summary: Shows row counts for the selected worksheet and lets you combine added, removed, modified, and conflict filters with keys 1–5; every new session starts unfiltered and filter changes keep your source-row position.
features.summaryZh: 摘要只显示当前工作表的行数；增加、删除、修改、冲突可多选，快捷键 1–4 切换分类、5 切换全部差异行与完整表格。每次启动默认显示完整数据，切换筛选会保留正在核对的原始行位置。

features.title: Controlled merge and undo
features.summary: Copies selected cells or rows into the writable left workbook, records merge decisions, and keeps every edit undoable.
features.summaryZh: 只把选中的单元格或行合并到可写左侧，记录处理结果，并让编辑与合并都可撤销。

features.title: Hold to compare before and after
features.summary: Hold the before-and-after control, or hold Tab while either grid is focused, to peek at the left workbook exactly as it was opened.
features.summaryZh: 改完不放心时，按住左侧的“前后对比”，或在任一表格聚焦后按住 Tab，就能暂时看到刚打开时的原样；松手马上回到最新结果，改过的格子也会单独标出来。

features.title: Git repository mode
features.titleZh: 本地 Git 仓库模式
features.summary: Reads the real worktree on the left and a validated local Git ref on the right without checkout, fetch, or branch mutation.
features.summaryZh: 左侧读取真实工作区，右侧从已验证的本地 Git 引用读取；不 checkout、不 fetch、不改分支。

features.title: Safe local save
features.summary: Detects external changes and uses same-directory temporary files, verification, sync, and atomic replacement.
features.summaryZh: 保存前检测外部修改，经过同目录临时文件、重开校验、同步与原子替换写回。

useCases.title: Review configuration workbooks
useCases.summaryZh: 在提交或发版前核对数值、公式、类型与行级变化。

useCases.title: Resolve XLSX changes in Git
useCases.titleZh: 处理 Git 中的 XLSX 变化
useCases.summaryZh: 直接比较工作区与本地分支或远端跟踪引用，不切换当前分支。

useCases.title: Merge selected corrections
useCases.summaryZh: 把确认过的单元格或整行复制到左侧，并在保存前随时撤销。
